scoring_scale: 0-100 per category; 90 means genuinely close visual correspondence. Scores are independent for this pass and do not inherit prior values.

pass_gate.required: Every room must score at least 90 in lighting, art_style and layout_fidelity after iteration.
pass_gate.reason: Pass 04 is closer, but each room still has at least one camera/composition mismatch plus lighting or material/content gaps.

BRIEFING.overall_read: The main composition is now close: TV, boards, two benches, console, poster and open portal are all readable. The frame is shifted left relative to the target, the plant is larger and simpler, and target-level warm fill and surface richness are still short.

HALL.overall_read: The corridor anchors and safety program are present. The left poster is oversized and its headline begins at the top edge; the extinguisher cylinder is fully visible but placed smaller/further left than the target, and the pipe remains an edge-held element.

LOCKER.overall_read: The pod, two benches, small tile floor, portal and two-bank locker arrangement remain valid. The foreground locker shifts the composition right, the lighting is still dark in locker/pod recesses, and the dressing/foliage is simpler than the target.

pixel_region_evidence.coordinate_basis: Approximate pixel regions in the 1600x900 pass-04 renders, measured by visual inspection; coordinates are evidence for framing comparisons, not automated segmentation.

The pass-04 right plant occupies approximately x1235-1455 and covers more of the wall-note area than the target plant, approximately x1360-1530. It is oversized/shifted rather than clipped.
HALL: The pass-04 large left poster spans approximately x165-465 and its headline begins at y0-15, with the top line clipped by the image edge. The target poster is approximately x75-300 and its headline begins well below the top edge around y75-95. This is a real poster scale/placement and framing mismatch.

The pass-04 extinguisher cylinder is fully inside the frame around x1295-1365, y545-690. It must not be described as cropped. The target cylinder sits further right/lower around x1435-1515, y565-760; the remaining issue is scale/placement. The vertical pipe at the far right is only partially visible around x1590-1600, matching the target's edge-held pipe treatment.
LOCKER: The pass-04 foreground locker bank occupies approximately x160-535, while the target's comparable foreground bank begins at the left edge and occupies roughly x0-335. The pass framing therefore shifts the bank right and narrows the portal view; this is a camera/composition mismatch.
The pass-04 pod spans approximately x930-1510 and is fully readable in its main body; the target spans roughly x960-1500. The pod is not treated as missing or incorrectly cropped.

Make the two physical banks read as four identical locker bodies with matching fronts, vents, handles and labels, and add the target-like towel/personal belongings to the entry locker. Ordinary jackets/towels are allowed; add no mannequin or displayed coverall suits.

limitations: This review compares still renders with target stills whose camera, lens and crop are not numerically calibrated. Pixel evidence is approximate visual measurement from 1600x900 images.
The target images are ChatGPT-generated. Text, exact poster graphics, portraits and incidental props are style/dressing cues rather than literal geometry requirements.

User constraints outrank accidental target details: preserve four identical lockers near entry in two physical banks, no mannequin/display coverall suits, exactly two briefing benches, a clear pod, open room entrances, matte timber, small bathroom tiles and used-but-maintained materials. Ordinary jackets and towels are authorized personal belongings.
Pass-04 was judged from the three REFERENCE_*.png renders only; no scene script, geometry, contact-check output or passage-ray output was used to increase visual scores.
